contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ [CON]STANTINVS IVN NC

A copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine II, AD335-337 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers and one standard. Mint is Trier. See RIC, vol.VII, p.223, no.591. Obverse legend reads: [CON]STANTINVS IVN NC. Obverse shows Laureate, cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis is 6 o'clock
